Latest build of **TrackIQ** (beta), updated automatically on every change. What changed in each version: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/kevincsv/Pitwall-test/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md).

| Platform | Download | How to install |
|---|---|---|
| Windows installer | [TrackIQ-Setup.exe](https://github.com/kevincsv/Pitwall-test/releases/download/pitlanehq-latest/TrackIQ-Setup.exe) | Run it (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway). No administrator needed |
| Windows (portable .zip) | [TrackIQ-windows.zip](https://github.com/kevincsv/Pitwall-test/releases/download/pitlanehq-latest/TrackIQ-windows.zip) | Unzip and run `TrackIQ.exe` |
| Windows · native window (preview) | [TrackIQ-Desktop.zip](https://github.com/kevincsv/Pitwall-test/releases/download/pitlanehq-latest/TrackIQ-Desktop.zip) | Unzip and run `TrackIQ.Desktop.exe`: the new native window over the same engine, being built screen by screen |
| Web version (your own site) | [![Deploy to Cloudflare](https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/button)](https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/?url=https://github.com/kevincsv/Pitwall-test/tree/pitlanehq-latest/cloud) | Free Cloudflare account; paste the key from TrackIQ → Settings → Connections when asked |

---

Última versión de **TrackIQ**, se actualiza sola con cada cambio. Windows: descomprime y abre `TrackIQ.exe`. Web: pulsa **Deploy to Cloudflare**, entra con tu cuenta gratuita y pega la clave de TrackIQ → Ajustes → Conexiones.
